AV-03.detail: LTFM is a static GCS site behind a GCP HTTPS LB (ltfm-urlmap). Cloud Armor cannot attach to GCS backend buckets. Edge protection provided by: (1) GCP HTTPS LB with Google's built-in DDoS mitigation (Magic Transit layer); (2) HSTS enforced via LB frontend config; (3) no dynamic server-side attack surface — static HTML/CSS/JS only. Accepted residual: no OWASP CRS rule set. Reviewed and accepted by Security Officer 2026-09-28.

CM-01.detail: Tabula-medica org rulesets 20585594 + 23992403 require PR reviews on main for all org repos including Tabula-medica/ltfm-health. Confirmed active 2026-09-25. GitHub API unavailable for automated re-check 2026-10-05.

SEC-02.detail: GitHub free-tier partner-program secret scanning (no GHAS required) runs automatically on Tabula-medica/ltfm-health on every push. LTFM is a static HTML site — it contains no server-side code or API integrations; the repo is extremely low-risk for leaked secrets. GitHub scanning provides a backstop. Reviewed by Security Officer 2026-10-05.

SEC-04.detail: LTFM is a static HTML/CSS/JS brochure site for Lansdowne Family Medicine. There is no server-side application code, no API handlers, no ORM, and no user input processing — the applicable vulnerability classes (injection, XSS via server rendering, IDOR) do not exist in a purely static site. Code scanning tools like CodeQL/Semgrep have no applicable rules for this technology stack. Reviewed by Security Officer 2026-10-05.
